instruction: Fix `binary_tree_height` so a single-node tree has height 1 (the current code under-counts by one because it drops the leading 1).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds.py b/ds.py
--- a/ds.py
+++ b/ds.py
@@ -113,4 +113,4 @@
     """Return the height of a binary tree (0 for an empty tree)."""
     if root is None:
         return 0
-    return max(binary_tree_height(root.left), binary_tree_height(root.right))
+    return 1 + max(binary_tree_height(root.left), binary_tree_height(root.right))
